name: quiet-prompt-owner-only

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/quiet_test.go — the prompt goes to the sender when the sender is the owner, else to every attached client of the owner, else nobody; an answer is accepted only from a client sent that prompt_id and only while outstanding; yes ends the session killed / owner, no leaves it

description: quiet_prompt (session model §11; Tu, 2026-09-26; orchestrator DEFAULT for the audience and the answer rule, approval page): input unanswered for quiet_prompt, the link alive and the sender attached, and TSB asks the owner "Kill the session?" — the text fixed like the recording warning. The sender's client is asked when the sender is the owner; otherwise every attached client of the owner, the first valid answer winning; nobody when the owner has none attached. Other attached clients never get the question: lifecycle authority is the owner token's (Contract §10). The core accepts quiet_prompt_answer only from a client it sent that prompt_id to, and only while that prompt is outstanding; prompt_id is unguessable, so a C2 frame can never end a session without the owner's authority. Yes → killed / owner; no → nothing. It is an answer, not an ack: no delivered position (decision 5.15).

instances.note: an answer, not an ack: no delivered position
